description: Elections Commission - M. A. M. P. Marasinghe of the Nattandiya Pradeshya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna Party - J. A. D. P. Kumar of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna Party
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes as it concerns the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
